cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Move It for Me
cards.instruction: Get someone to rearrange an ordinary commitment as proof that your relationship takes priority.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Leave the quiz for my exhibition opening. Name a deputy before you go; that's how a captain hands over properly.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They'll think I've abandoned them for my sister.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Delegation isn't abandonment. Give the deputy the answer sheet and tell the team where you're going.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll leave after round one and say I've got a headache.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No: 'My sister's opening.' Give them the correct reason when you hand over. Don't make coming to me sound like sick leave.

reason: Make professional delegation and accurate reporting turn a schedule change into explicit proof of sibling priority, with B excuse causing the final correction.
